predict: LOGICOL stands for Logically-Informed Contrastive Learning for Set-based Dense Retrieval. It is a logically-informed contrastive learning framework used for retrieval tasks, particularly in the context of dense retrievers. LOGICOL incorporates logical constraints into its learning objective, aiming to improve the performance of models in set-based dense retrieval tasks. It builds on in-batch supervised contrastive learning and is designed to leverage logical information to enhance the learning process.
